text: Physical production and test trees are layered. Generic fitted capabilities are family-neutral; PLSC/CCA/RRR and transfer form family.paired; exact direct-sum execution moved to family.multiblock so spectral has no reverse multiblock edge. multivar, multivar-ir, inference, mvpa-fit, and graph-linalg consumers compile on JVM and Scala.js. Package law docs and compile-time hierarchy tests added; full testAll gate remains.
